text: Aapne zaroor suna hoga ki insaan dimaag ka sirf 10 percent use karta hai, lekin yeh bilkul jhooth hai.
mood: curious electronic synth pulse with an intrigued undertone

text: Brain scans dikhate hain ki simple baat karte waqt ya sote hue bhi, poora dimaag active rehta hai.
mood: bright ascending ambient pads, scientific discovery

text: Dimaag body ka sirf do percent weight leta hai, par poore shareer ki 20 percent energy akele consume karta hai.
mood: rhythmic ticking bassline with electronic energy

text: Agar 90 percent dimaag sach mein bekaar hota, toh nature aisi useless energy waste kabhi allow nahi karti.
Medical reality yeh hai ki agar dimaag ke kisi ek percent chhotey hisse par bhi chot lag jaye,
mood: ominous low drone and tense riser, medical danger

text: toh insaan apni bolne ya chalne ki ability hamesha ke liye kho sakta hai.
Yeh myth bas ek purani research ko galat samajhne ki wajah se faila tha.
Toh sach yeh hai ki aap abhi bhi apna poora dimaag use kar rahe hain, chahe aapko aisa feel ho ya na ho.
mood: triumphant yet witty synthesizer loop resolving cleanly
